items.role: 빠른 소형 적 추적과 지속 압박. 장갑 효율과 과열 관리가 약점이다.
limitations: Generated visual prototype. Mechanical part separation, pivots, firing sockets, collision and engine performance are not finalized.
Toon shading and outlines are runtime workbench materials, not universal shaders embedded in the original GLB.
Mounting view is an external deck placement study. The original single-mesh airship and its existing gun are preserved.
Unseen sides were inferred from one reference image.
